facts.text: Snow left Horse Meadow (8,580 ft) and Burnside Lake (8,180 ft) 17 to 26 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Horse Meadow
evidence.detail: left April 27; earlier seasons: June 30 (2023), May 23 (2024), May 14 (2025)

evidence.name: Burnside Lake
evidence.detail: left April 30; earlier seasons: June 19 (2023), May 17 (2024), May 8 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Horse Meadow (8,580 ft) and Burnside Lake (8,180 ft).

evidence.name: Horse Meadow
evidence.detail: 2.5 in on April 12; earlier seasons: 54.0 in (2023), 22.0 in (2024), 19.2 in (2025)

evidence.name: Burnside Lake
evidence.detail: 6.3 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 61.4 in (2023), 24.0 in (2024), 19.5 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between March 21 and May 14, carried from the melt-out dates at Horse Meadow (8,580 ft) and Burnside Lake (8,180 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Horse Meadow
evidence.detail: melted out April 27, 844 ft above the pass; points to March 15 to May 10

evidence.name: Burnside Lake
evidence.detail: melted out April 30, 444 ft above the pass; points to March 28 to May 17
